how.intro: Smartger keeps every fact about a complex under construction together with its source and date. This page explains what each label and level means.
how.company.title: Verified company
how.company.text: A green "Verified company" label means Smartger has checked the company’s registration and contact details. It does not mean every claim is true; each claim is labelled separately.
how.levels.title: Four levels of progress verification
how.levels.text: Each progress entry shows how reliably it was checked, from level 1 to 4. Higher is more reliable.
how.levels.l1: The company submitted a report itself. Smartger has not checked it.
how.levels.l2: A photo showing date and location. Smartger has checked the date.
how.levels.l3: An independent engineer checks on site. Who pays for this is not decided yet.
how.levels.l4: Continuous monitoring by camera or drone.
how.sources.title: The source of every figure
how.sources.company: Stated by the company but not checked against documents.
how.sources.smartger: Checked or estimated by Smartger itself.
how.sources.document: Confirmed by an official document (permit, contract, etc.).
how.prices.title: Three kinds of price
how.prices.developer: The price the company advertises, with when and where it came from.
how.prices.listing: Listing prices and the National Statistics Office average, shown as a reference point.
how.prices.deal: Actual deal prices confirmed by documents such as contracts. Shown as "not found" in the demo.
how.notFound.title: What "not found" means
how.notFound.text: When information is missing or the company has not published it, we never leave it blank. A yellow "not found" label shows exactly what is missing.
how.promise.title: Promise snapshot
how.promise.text: On the day a project joins Smartger we record its price, handover date, plan and amenity promises, and never change them. Today’s situation is compared against this to show delays or changes.
how.map.title: Map pins
how.map.text: How full a pin is shows the building stage. The number is how many units are available. Projects not updated for over 60 days look faded. Sold-out complexes are hidden by default.
report.demoText: This shows what a monthly report for a buyer living abroad could look like. All people and figures are fictional. Nothing is actually sent and there is no sign-up.

report.tip2: Compare with the original promise on the Promises tab.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.1.p: You can browse without signing in. We do not collect personal details such as your name or phone. Your language, theme and compare choices stay on your own device.
privacy.2.p: When you sign up, your email, company name, phone (if given) and password (stored encrypted) are kept. Every change is logged with who made it and when. Deleting an account removes its sign-in details.
privacy.3.p: When you upload a photo, its date and, if you allow it, your phone location are saved. Please upload construction site photos only, without faces or number plates. Published photos are public.
privacy.4.p: Data is stored with Supabase and the site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Map tiles come from OpenStreetMap, so your IP address reaches their servers.
privacy.5.p: We do not sell or pass on personal data. Project information that Smartger has checked and published is public.
privacy.6.p: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data. Demo contact: privacy@example.com (fictional).
privacy.7.p: This will follow Mongolia's Law on Personal Data Protection. A lawyer will review and confirm the details.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.1.p: All companies, projects, prices and people shown are fictional. Do not use them for real decisions.
terms.2.p: Smartger is not a listings site but a record of project evidence. We do not predict prices, promise returns or give investment advice.
terms.3.p: Companies must enter accurate information with a source and date for every number, and must have the right to use the photos and documents they upload.
terms.4.p: Company entries are not published until Smartger checks and approves them. Smartger may reject entries that are wrong or lack evidence.
terms.5.p: Companies sign up on the site and can add information once Smartger checks and links the account. Do not share your password. Changes made with your account are kept in the history. Smartger may delete accounts.
terms.6.p: If these terms change, the new version will be posted here with its date.
